file_write.reviewer: 用户明确授权的本地维护请求
file_write.reason: 用户明确要求优化本地技能、同步安装目录和治理指定 Obsidian Vault；写入边界只覆盖这些目标，不扩大到未批准来源。
file_write.scope: 仅允许写入选定 Vault 目标、显式指定的上下文简报输出目录和技能包工作树；原始来源资产保持只读。

target_enforcement.openai: Agent must keep the explicit Vault/source boundary and show preview before write.
target_enforcement.claude: Agent must keep the explicit Vault/source boundary and show preview before write.
target_enforcement.generic: Caller must provide the selected Vault/source boundary and review the preview.
target_enforcement.vscode: Workspace instructions must preserve the explicit Vault/source boundary and preview gate.
